newsitem.title: USA: American List details deal with Snyder.
newsitem.headline: American List details deal with Snyder.

text.p: American List Corp on Wednesday said the number of shares Snyder Communications Inc may issue in connection with their earlier reported merger agreement will depend on the average trading price of Snyder stock.
The stock swap merger deal was initially valued by American List at $125 million.

American List said that if the average trading price of Snyder common stock for the 20-day period ending the third day before the closing of the deal is equal to or exceeds $32, one common share of Snyder will be exchanged for each share of American List common share.
At $32 and based on American List's 4.5 million common shares, the deal would be valued at $144.0 million.
If the average price is $28 or more but is less than $32, the number of Snyder shares to be issued for each American List share will be equal to the quotient of $32 divided by the average price.
If the average price equals or exceeds $26, but is less than $28, Snyder will issue 1.14 shares for each American List share.

If the average is less than $26 and the agreement is not terminated, the number of shares Snyder will swap for each American List share will equal to the quotient of $29.71 divided by the average trading price.
American List also said it was correcting its earlier reported net income per share for the fourth quarter ended February 1996 to $0.55, instead of $0.42.
